newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary c.bank sells HUF67.75 bln of 1998/I bonds.
newsitem.headline: Hungary c.bank sells HUF67.75 bln of 1998/I bonds.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) sold 67.75 billion forints worth of the first series (1998/I) of its one-year bonds between June 20 and July 9, the central bank said in a statement on Monday.
The NBH said in the state securities watchdog APTF's official gazette that it closed the subsciption of the bonds earlier than originally planned due to large demand.
It added that 61.5 percent of the bonds, sold to domestic investors, was subscribed by banks and 38.5 percent by primary government security traders.
The yield on the one-year NBH bonds, first issued in June, provides a support level for twelve-month discount Treasury bill yields and influences other government security yields.
The NBH plans to sell the second series of the one-year bonds (1998/II), worth a total 75 billion forints, between July 9 and August 8 but it may close or suspend the sales earlier.
The annual yield on the bonds is 20.03 percent.
